analyses.title: 月度实际产量趋势
analyses.sql: SELECT substr(date,1,7) AS month, SUM(actual_quantity) AS total_actual_quantity FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY GROUP BY substr(date,1,7) ORDER BY month LIMIT 500

analyses.title: 月度计划产量与实际产量对比
analyses.sql: SELECT substr(date,1,7) AS month, SUM(planned_quantity) AS total_planned_quantity, SUM(actual_quantity) AS total_actual_quantity FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY GROUP BY substr(date,1,7) ORDER BY month LIMIT 500

analyses.title: 月度良品率趋势
analyses.sql: SELECT substr(date,1,7) AS month, AVG(yield_rate) AS avg_yield_rate FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY GROUP BY substr(date,1,7) ORDER BY month LIMIT 500
